from pathlib import Path
import json,re
root=Path.cwd()

def w(rel,s):
 p=root/rel;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(s)

def r(rel): return (root/rel).read_text()
# schema
s=r('src/data/database/schema.ts')
s=s.replace("import type { TradeExecutionRecord, TradeFeeRecord, TradePlanRecord, TradeRecord } from '../../domain/trades';", "import type { SavedAnalysis } from '../../app/savedAnalysisContract';\nimport type { TradeExecutionRecord, TradeFeeRecord, TradePlanRecord, TradeRecord } from '../../domain/trades';")
s=s.replace("export const KAIROS_DB_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3 as const;", "export const KAIROS_DB_SCHEMA_VERSION = 4 as const;")
s=s.replace("export const KAIROS_V3_STORES = Object.freeze({\n  trades: '&id,status,symbol,updatedAt,[status+updatedAt]',\n});", "export const KAIROS_V3_STORES = Object.freeze({\n  trades: '&id,status,symbol,updatedAt,[status+updatedAt]',\n});\n\n/** V4 appends Saved Analysis persistence without rewriting released history. */\nexport const KAIROS_V4_STORES = Object.freeze({\n  savedAnalyses: '&id',\n});\n\n/** Current complete store authority used by transactions/integrity only. */\nexport const KAIROS_CURRENT_STORES = Object.freeze({\n  ...KAIROS_V2_STORES,\n  ...KAIROS_V3_STORES,\n  ...KAIROS_V4_STORES,\n});")
s += "\nexport type DatabaseSavedAnalysisRecord = SavedAnalysis;\n"
w('src/data/database/schema.ts',s)
# db
s=r('src/data/database/KairosDatabase.ts')
s=s.replace("type DatabaseMetadataRecord,", "type DatabaseMetadataRecord,\n  type DatabaseSavedAnalysisRecord,")
s=s.replace("readonly tradeFees!: EntityTable<DatabaseTradeFeeRecord, 'id'>;", "readonly tradeFees!: EntityTable<DatabaseTradeFeeRecord, 'id'>;\n  readonly savedAnalyses!: EntityTable<DatabaseSavedAnalysisRecord, 'id'>;")
w('src/data/database/KairosDatabase.ts',s)
# migrations
s=r('src/data/database/migrations.ts')
s=s.replace("KAIROS_V1_STORES, KAIROS_V2_STORES, KAIROS_V3_STORES", "KAIROS_V1_STORES, KAIROS_V2_STORES, KAIROS_V3_STORES, KAIROS_V4_STORES")
s=s.replace("const KAIROS_V3_MIGRATION: KairosMigrationDefinition = Object.freeze({ version: 3, stores: KAIROS_V3_STORES });", "const KAIROS_V3_MIGRATION: KairosMigrationDefinition = Object.freeze({ version: 3, stores: KAIROS_V3_STORES });\nconst KAIROS_V4_MIGRATION: KairosMigrationDefinition = Object.freeze({ version: 4, stores: KAIROS_V4_STORES });")
s=s.replace("Object.freeze([KAIROS_V1_MIGRATION, KAIROS_V2_MIGRATION, KAIROS_V3_MIGRATION])", "Object.freeze([KAIROS_V1_MIGRATION, KAIROS_V2_MIGRATION, KAIROS_V3_MIGRATION, KAIROS_V4_MIGRATION])")
w('src/data/database/migrations.ts',s)
# transactions
s=r('src/data/database/transactions.ts').replace("KAIROS_V2_STORES", "KAIROS_CURRENT_STORES")
w('src/data/database/transactions.ts',s)
# repositories new
w('src/data/repositories/SavedAnalysisRepository.ts',"""import type { SavedAnalysis, SavedAnalysisId } from '../../app/savedAnalysisContract';\nimport type { KairosDatabase } from '../database/KairosDatabase';\n\nexport class SavedAnalysisRepository {\n  constructor(private readonly db: KairosDatabase) {}\n  get(id: SavedAnalysisId) { return this.db.savedAnalyses.get(id); }\n  listAll() { return this.db.savedAnalyses.toArray(); }\n  put(record: SavedAnalysis) { return this.db.savedAnalyses.put(record).then(() => undefined); }\n  delete(id: SavedAnalysisId) { return this.db.savedAnalyses.delete(id); }\n  async replaceAll(records: readonly SavedAnalysis[]) {\n    await this.db.savedAnalyses.clear();\n    if (records.length) await this.db.savedAnalyses.bulkPut(records.map((record) => structuredClone(record)));\n  }\n}\n""")
s=r('src/data/repositories/index.ts')
s=s.replace("import { MetadataRepository } from './MetadataRepository';", "import { MetadataRepository } from './MetadataRepository';\nimport { SavedAnalysisRepository } from './SavedAnalysisRepository';")
s=s.replace("readonly tradeFees: TradeFeeRepository;", "readonly tradeFees: TradeFeeRepository;\n  readonly savedAnalyses: SavedAnalysisRepository;")
s=s.replace("tradeFees: new TradeFeeRepository(db) });", "tradeFees: new TradeFeeRepository(db), savedAnalyses: new SavedAnalysisRepository(db) });")
s=s.replace("export { MetadataRepository } from './MetadataRepository';", "export { MetadataRepository } from './MetadataRepository';\nexport { SavedAnalysisRepository } from './SavedAnalysisRepository';")
w('src/data/repositories/index.ts',s)
# database index
s=r('src/data/database/index.ts')
s=s.replace("KAIROS_V1_STORES,\n  KAIROS_V3_STORES,", "KAIROS_V1_STORES,\n  KAIROS_V3_STORES,\n  KAIROS_V4_STORES,\n  KAIROS_CURRENT_STORES,")
s=s.replace("export type { DatabaseMetadataRecord } from './schema';", "export type { DatabaseMetadataRecord, DatabaseSavedAnalysisRecord } from './schema';")
w('src/data/database/index.ts',s)
# integrity rewrite focused
w('src/data/database/integrity.ts',"""import type { KairosDatabase } from './KairosDatabase';\nimport { KAIROS_CURRENT_STORES, KAIROS_DB_SCHEMA_VERSION } from './schema';\nimport { validateTradeRecord, parsePositiveDecimalString } from '../../domain/trades';\n\nexport type DatabaseIntegrityCheckId = 'database-open'|'schema-version'|'store-set'|'metadata-primary-key'|'metadata-record-shape'|'trade-primary-keys'|'trade-record-shape'|'trade-reference-integrity'|'saved-analysis-primary-key'|'saved-analysis-record-shape';\nexport interface DatabaseIntegrityCheck { readonly id: DatabaseIntegrityCheckId; readonly ok: boolean; readonly detail: string; }\nexport interface DatabaseIntegrityReport { readonly ok:boolean; readonly schemaVersion:number; readonly checkedAt:string; readonly metadataRecordCount:number; readonly tradeRecordCount:number; readonly savedAnalysisRecordCount:number; readonly checks:readonly DatabaseIntegrityCheck[]; }\nexport class DatabaseIntegrityError extends Error { constructor(public readonly report:DatabaseIntegrityReport){ const failed=report.checks.filter(c=>!c.ok).map(c=>c.id).join(', '); super(`Kairos database integrity check failed: ${failed || 'unknown invariant'}.`); this.name='DatabaseIntegrityError'; } }\nconst check=(id:DatabaseIntegrityCheckId,ok:boolean,detail:string):DatabaseIntegrityCheck=>Object.freeze({id,ok,detail});\nfunction iso(v:unknown):v is string { if(typeof v!=='string'||!v)return false; const p=Date.parse(v); return Number.isFinite(p)&&new Date(p).toISOString()===v; }\nfunction metadata(v:unknown){ if(typeof v!=='object'||v===null||Array.isArray(v))return false; const x=v as Record<string,unknown>; return typeof x.key==='string'&&!!x.key&&typeof x.value==='string'&&iso(x.updatedAt); }\nfunction savedAnalysis(v:unknown){ if(typeof v!=='object'||v===null||Array.isArray(v))return false; const x=v as Record<string,unknown>; return typeof x.id==='string'&&!!x.id&&typeof x.market==='object'&&x.market!==null&&Array.isArray(x.drawings)&&Array.isArray(x.riskRewards); }\nexport async function inspectKairosDatabaseIntegrity(db:KairosDatabase):Promise<DatabaseIntegrityReport>{\n const checks:DatabaseIntegrityCheck[]=[]; const open=db.isOpen(); checks.push(check('database-open',open,open?'Database connection is open.':'Database connection is not open.'));\n checks.push(check('schema-version',db.verno===KAIROS_DB_SCHEMA_VERSION,`Expected schema v${KAIROS_DB_SCHEMA_VERSION}; found v${db.verno}.`));\n const names=db.tables.map(t=>t.name).sort(); const expected=Object.keys(KAIROS_CURRENT_STORES).sort(); checks.push(check('store-set',JSON.stringify(names)===JSON.stringify(expected),`Expected ${expected.join(', ')}; found ${names.join(', ')||'none'}.`));\n const mt=db.tables.find(t=>t.name==='metadata'); checks.push(check('metadata-primary-key',mt?.schema.primKey.keyPath==='key',`Expected metadata primary key \"key\"; found ${String(mt?.schema.primKey.keyPath??'missing')}.`));\n const tradeTables=['trades','tradePlans','tradeExecutions','tradeFees'].map(n=>db.tables.find(t=>t.name===n)); checks.push(check('trade-primary-keys',tradeTables.every(t=>t?.schema.primKey.keyPath==='id'),'All trade stores must use stable id primary keys.'));\n const sat=db.tables.find(t=>t.name==='savedAnalyses'); checks.push(check('saved-analysis-primary-key',sat?.schema.primKey.keyPath==='id','Saved Analysis store must use stable id primary key.'));\n let metadataRecordCount=0, tradeRecordCount=0, savedAnalysisRecordCount=0; let metadataOk=false, shapeOk=false, refsOk=false, savedOk=false;\n if(open&&mt&&sat&&tradeTables.every(Boolean)){\n   const ms=await mt.toArray(); metadataRecordCount=ms.length; metadataOk=ms.every(metadata);\n   const trades=await db.trades.toArray(), plans=await db.tradePlans.toArray(), executions=await db.tradeExecutions.toArray(), fees=await db.tradeFees.toArray(), saved=await db.savedAnalyses.toArray(); tradeRecordCount=trades.length; savedAnalysisRecordCount=saved.length; savedOk=saved.every(savedAnalysis);\n   shapeOk=trades.every(t=>validateTradeRecord(t).ok)&&plans.every(p=>p.plannedQuantity===null||parsePositiveDecimalString(p.plannedQuantity).ok)&&executions.every(e=>parsePositiveDecimalString(e.price).ok&&parsePositiveDecimalString(e.quantity).ok)&&fees.every(f=>parsePositiveDecimalString(f.amount).ok);\n   const ids=new Set(trades.map(t=>t.id)); const execIds=new Set(executions.map(e=>e.id)); refsOk=plans.every(p=>ids.has(p.tradeId))&&executions.every(e=>ids.has(e.tradeId))&&fees.every(f=>ids.has(f.tradeId)&&(f.executionId===null||execIds.has(f.executionId)));\n }\n checks.push(check('metadata-record-shape',metadataOk,metadataOk?`Validated ${metadataRecordCount} metadata record(s).`:'Metadata record contract failed.'));\n checks.push(check('trade-record-shape',shapeOk,shapeOk?'Trade persistence record shapes are valid.':'Trade persistence record shape failed.'));\n checks.push(check('trade-reference-integrity',refsOk,refsOk?'Trade references are internally consistent.':'Trade reference integrity failed.'));\n checks.push(check('saved-analysis-record-shape',savedOk,savedOk?`Validated ${savedAnalysisRecordCount} Saved Analysis record(s).`:'Saved Analysis record contract failed.'));\n return Object.freeze({ok:checks.every(c=>c.ok),schemaVersion:db.verno,checkedAt:new Date().toISOString(),metadataRecordCount,tradeRecordCount,savedAnalysisRecordCount,checks:Object.freeze(checks)});\n}\nexport async function assertKairosDatabaseIntegrity(db:KairosDatabase){const report=await inspectKairosDatabaseIntegrity(db);if(!report.ok)throw new DatabaseIntegrityError(report);return report;}\n""")
# backup format wholesale
w('src/data/backup/backupFormat.ts',"""import type { SavedAnalysis } from '../../app/savedAnalysisContract';\nimport type { DatabaseMetadataRecord, DatabaseTradeExecutionRecord, DatabaseTradeFeeRecord, DatabaseTradePlanRecord, DatabaseTradeRecord } from '../database/schema';\n\nexport const KAIROS_BACKUP_FORMAT_NAME = 'kairos-full-backup' as const;\nexport const KAIROS_BACKUP_FORMAT_VERSION = 3 as const;\nexport const KAIROS_LEGACY_BACKUP_FORMAT_VERSION = 1 as const;\nexport const KAIROS_TRADE_BACKUP_FORMAT_VERSION = 2 as const;\n\nexport interface KairosBackupPayloadV1 { readonly metadata: readonly DatabaseMetadataRecord[]; }\nexport interface KairosBackupRecordCountsV1 { readonly metadata:number; readonly total:number; }\nexport interface KairosBackupEnvelopeV1 { readonly formatName:typeof KAIROS_BACKUP_FORMAT_NAME; readonly formatVersion:1; readonly appVersion:string; readonly buildId:string; readonly exportedAt:string; readonly databaseSchemaVersion:1; readonly recordCounts:KairosBackupRecordCountsV1; readonly payload:KairosBackupPayloadV1; }\n\nexport interface KairosBackupPayloadV2 { readonly metadata:readonly DatabaseMetadataRecord[]; readonly trades:readonly DatabaseTradeRecord[]; readonly tradePlans:readonly DatabaseTradePlanRecord[]; readonly tradeExecutions:readonly DatabaseTradeExecutionRecord[]; readonly tradeFees:readonly DatabaseTradeFeeRecord[]; }\nexport interface KairosBackupRecordCountsV2 { readonly metadata:number; readonly trades:number; readonly tradePlans:number; readonly tradeExecutions:number; readonly tradeFees:number; readonly total:number; }\nexport interface KairosBackupEnvelopeV2 { readonly formatName:typeof KAIROS_BACKUP_FORMAT_NAME; readonly formatVersion:2; readonly appVersion:string; readonly buildId:string; readonly exportedAt:string; readonly databaseSchemaVersion:2|3; readonly recordCounts:KairosBackupRecordCountsV2; readonly payload:KairosBackupPayloadV2; }\n\nexport interface KairosBackupPayloadV3 extends KairosBackupPayloadV2 { readonly savedAnalyses: readonly SavedAnalysis[]; }\nexport interface KairosBackupRecordCountsV3 extends KairosBackupRecordCountsV2 { readonly savedAnalyses:number; }\nexport interface KairosBackupEnvelopeV3 { readonly formatName:typeof KAIROS_BACKUP_FORMAT_NAME; readonly formatVersion:3; readonly appVersion:string; readonly buildId:string; readonly exportedAt:string; readonly databaseSchemaVersion:4; readonly recordCounts:KairosBackupRecordCountsV3; readonly payload:KairosBackupPayloadV3; }\n\nexport type KairosBackupEnvelope = KairosBackupEnvelopeV1|KairosBackupEnvelopeV2|KairosBackupEnvelopeV3;\nexport type KairosCurrentBackupEnvelope = KairosBackupEnvelopeV3;\n""")
# envelope wholesale
